summary: A short passage about research; a study; CL:項|项[xiang4]; to research; to look into.
summary_en: A short passage about research; a study; CL:項|项[xiang4]; to research; to look into.

paragraphs.text: 她加入了语言学学会，希望认识更多同行研究者。
paragraphs.hanzi: 她加入了语言学学会，希望认识更多同行研究者。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā jiā rù le yǔ yán xué xué huì ， xī wàng rèn shí gèng duō tóng háng yán jiū zhě 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄖㄨˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄩˇ ㄧㄢˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ， ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄖㄣˋ ㄕˊ ㄍㄥˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄏㄤˊ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄓㄜˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā jiārù le yǔyánxué xuéhuì, xīwàng rènshi gèng duō tóngháng yánjiūzhě.
paragraphs.translation: She joined the linguistics society, hoping to meet more fellow researchers.
paragraphs.translation_en: She joined the linguistics society, hoping to meet more fellow researchers.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia bergabung dengan perkumpulan linguistik, dengan harapan dapat bertemu lebih banyak rekan peneliti.

paragraphs.text: 这项研究只招收二十到三十岁的健康女子。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这项研究只招收二十到三十岁的健康女子。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè xiàng yán jiū zhǐ zhāo shōu èr shí dào sān shí suì de jiàn kāng nǚ zǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄓˇ ㄓㄠ ㄕㄡ ㄦˋ ㄕˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄙㄢ ㄕˊ ㄙㄨㄟˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄎㄤ ㄋㄩˇ ㄗˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè xiàng yánjiū zhǐ zhāoshōu èrshí dào sānshí suì de jiànkāng nǚzǐ.
paragraphs.translation: This study only recruits healthy women aged twenty to thirty.
paragraphs.translation_en: This study only recruits healthy women aged twenty to thirty.
paragraphs.translation_id: Penelitian ini hanya merekrut perempuan sehat berusia dua puluh hingga tiga puluh tahun.

paragraphs.text: 长期的挫折使他重新思考自己的研究方向。
paragraphs.hanzi: 长期的挫折使他重新思考自己的研究方向。
paragraphs.pinyin: cháng qī de cuò zhé shǐ tā chóng xīn sī kǎo zì jǐ de yán jiū fāng xiàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄧ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄘㄨㄛˋ ㄓㄜˊ ㄕˇ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄙ ㄎㄠˇ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄈㄤ ㄒㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Chángqī de cuòzhé shǐ tā chóngxīn sīkǎo zìjǐ de yánjiū fāngxiàng.
paragraphs.translation: Long-term setbacks made him rethink the direction of his research.
paragraphs.translation_en: Long-term setbacks made him rethink the direction of his research.
paragraphs.translation_id: Kemunduran jangka panjang membuatnya memikirkan kembali arah penelitiannya.

paragraphs.text: 他研究商业管理，希望以后自己开公司。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他研究商业管理，希望以后自己开公司。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā yán jiū shāng yè guǎn lǐ ， xī wàng yǐ hòu zì jǐ kāi gōng sī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄕㄤ ㄧㄝˋ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ， ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄎㄞ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā yánjiū shāngyè guǎnlǐ, xīwàng yǐhòu zìjǐ kāi gōngsī.
paragraphs.translation: He studies business management and hopes to start his own company in the future.
paragraphs.translation_en: He studies business management and hopes to start his own company in the future.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia sedang menempuh studi di bidang manajemen bisnis dan berharap dapat mendirikan perusahaannya sendiri di masa depan.

paragraphs.text: 科学家正在研究如何利用细菌合成可降解材料。
paragraphs.hanzi: 科学家正在研究如何利用细菌合成可降解材料。
paragraphs.pinyin: kē xué jiā zhèng zài yán jiū rú hé lì yòng xì jūn hé chéng kě jiàng jiě cái liào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄎㄜ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄐㄧㄚ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ ㄖㄨˊ ㄏㄜˊ ㄌㄧˋ ㄩㄥˋ ㄒㄧˋ ㄐㄩㄣ ㄏㄜˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄎㄜˇ ㄐㄧㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Kēxuéjiā zhèngzài yánjiū rúhé lìyòng xìjūn héchéng kě jiàngjiě cáiliào.
paragraphs.translation: Scientists are studying how to use bacteria to synthesise biodegradable materials.
paragraphs.translation_en: Scientists are studying how to use bacteria to synthesise biodegradable materials.
paragraphs.translation_id: Para ilmuwan sedang mempelajari cara menggunakan bakteri untuk mensintesis bahan yang dapat terbiodegradasi.

paragraphs.text: 他对古文字特别感兴趣，常常去博物馆研究。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他对古文字特别感兴趣，常常去博物馆研究。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā duì gǔ wén zì tè bié gǎn xìng qù ， cháng cháng qù bó wù guǎn yán jiū 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄉㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨˇ ㄨㄣˊ ㄗˋ ㄊㄜˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄢˇ ㄒㄧㄥˋ ㄑㄩˋ ， ㄔㄤˊ ㄔㄤˊ ㄑㄩˋ ㄅㄛˊ ㄨˋ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄧㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄡ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā duì gǔ wénzì tèbié gǎn xìngqù, chángcháng qù bówùguǎn yánjiū.
paragraphs.translation: He is especially interested in ancient writing and often goes to museums to study it.
paragraphs.translation_en: He is especially interested in ancient writing and often goes to museums to study it.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia sangat tertarik pada tulisan kuno dan sering mengunjungi museum untuk mempelajarinya.

title: 真正 — genuine; real; true; really; indeed
title_en: 真正 — genuine; real; true; really; indeed
summary: A short passage about genuine; real; true; really; indeed.
summary_en: A short passage about genuine; real; true; really; indeed.

paragraphs.text: 真正成熟的人不是从不求助，而是知道什么时候需要别人支持。
paragraphs.hanzi: 真正成熟的人不是从不求助，而是知道什么时候需要别人支持。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng chéng shú de rén bú shì cóng bù qiú zhù ， ér shì zhī dào shén me shí hòu xū yào bié rén zhī chí 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕㄨˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄓㄨˋ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄓ ㄉㄠˋ ㄕㄣˊ ㄇㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄏㄡˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄓ ㄔˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhēnzhèng chéngshú de rén bú shì cóng bù qiúzhù, ér shì zhīdào shénme shíhou xūyào biérén zhīchí.
paragraphs.translation: A truly mature person is not someone who never asks for help, but someone who knows when support is needed.
paragraphs.translation_en: A truly mature person is not someone who never asks for help, but someone who knows when support is needed.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang yang benar-benar dewasa bukanlah orang yang tidak pernah meminta bantuan, tapi orang yang tahu kapan dukungan dibutuhkan.

paragraphs.text: 别只说空话安慰别人，真正的帮助更重要。
paragraphs.hanzi: 别只说空话安慰别人，真正的帮助更重要。
paragraphs.pinyin: bié zhǐ shuō kōng huà ān wèi bié rén ， zhēn zhèng de bāng zhù gèng zhòng yào 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄓˇ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄎㄨㄥ ㄏㄨㄚˋ ㄢ ㄨㄟˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄅㄤ ㄓㄨˋ ㄍㄥˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄠˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Bié zhǐ shuō kōnghuà ānwèi biéren, zhēnzhèng de bāngzhù gèng zhòngyào.
paragraphs.translation: Don’t just comfort people with empty words; real help is more important.
paragraphs.translation_en: Don’t just comfort people with empty words; real help is more important.
paragraphs.translation_id: Jangan hanya menghibur orang dengan kata-kata kosong; bantuan nyata lebih penting.

paragraphs.text: 真正成熟的人不会过分在意一时的得失。
paragraphs.hanzi: 真正成熟的人不会过分在意一时的得失。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng chéng shú de rén bú huì guò fèn zài yì yī shí de dé shī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕㄨˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄧˋ ㄧ ㄕˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄜˊ ㄕ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhēnzhèng chéngshú de rén bú huì guòfèn zàiyì yìshí de déshī.
paragraphs.translation: Truly mature people do not care too much about temporary gains and losses.
paragraphs.translation_en: Truly mature people do not care too much about temporary gains and losses.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang yang benar-benar dewasa tidak terlalu peduli dengan keuntungan dan kerugian sementara.

paragraphs.text: 父母希望她嫁给一个真正尊重她的人。
paragraphs.hanzi: 父母希望她嫁给一个真正尊重她的人。
paragraphs.pinyin: fù mǔ xī wàng tā jià gěi yí gè zhēn zhèng zūn zhòng tā de rén 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄈㄨˋ ㄇㄨˇ ㄒㄧ ㄨㄤˋ ㄊㄚ ㄐㄧㄚˋ ㄍㄟˇ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜˋ ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄗㄨㄣ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄊㄚ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄖㄣˊ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Fùmǔ xīwàng tā jià gěi yí ge zhēnzhèng zūnzhòng tā de rén.
paragraphs.translation: Her parents hope she will marry someone who truly respects her.
paragraphs.translation_en: Her parents hope she will marry someone who truly respects her.
paragraphs.translation_id: Orang tuanya berharap dia akan menikah dengan seseorang yang benar-benar menghormatinya.

paragraphs.text: 真正的朋友不多，遇到了就要珍惜。
paragraphs.hanzi: 真正的朋友不多，遇到了就要珍惜。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhēn zhèng de péng yǒu bù duō ， yù dào le jiù yào zhēn xī 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄆㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ， ㄩˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄓㄣ ㄒㄧ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhēnzhèng de péngyou bù duō, yùdào le jiù yào zhēnxī.
paragraphs.translation: True friends are not many; when you meet them, you should cherish them.
paragraphs.translation_en: True friends are not many; when you meet them, you should cherish them.
paragraphs.translation_id: Teman sejati tidak banyak; ketika kamu bertemu mereka, kamu harus menghargai mereka.

paragraphs.text: 在这部小说里，真正的敌人不是别人，而是主人公自己的恐惧。
paragraphs.hanzi: 在这部小说里，真正的敌人不是别人，而是主人公自己的恐惧。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài zhè bù xiǎo shuō lǐ ， zhēn zhèng de dí rén bú shì bié rén ， ér shì zhǔ rén gōng zì jǐ de kǒng jù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄒㄧㄠˇ ㄕㄨㄛ ㄌㄧˇ ， ㄓㄣ ㄓㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄉㄧˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄅㄨˊ ㄕˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ， ㄦˊ ㄕˋ ㄓㄨˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄎㄨㄥˇ ㄐㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zài zhè bù xiǎoshuō lǐ, zhēnzhèng de dírén bú shì biérén, ér shì zhǔréngōng zìjǐ de kǒngjù.
paragraphs.translation: In this novel, the real enemy is not another person, but the main character’s own fear.
paragraphs.translation_en: In this novel, the real enemy is not another person, but the main character’s own fear.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dalam novel ini, musuh sebenarnya bukanlah orang lain, melainkan ketakutan sang tokoh utama sendiri.

title: 重新 — again; once more; re-
title_en: 重新 — again; once more; re-
summary: A short passage about again; once more; re-.
summary_en: A short passage about again; once more; re-.

paragraphs.text: 他决定告别过去的生活，去一个新的城市重新开始。
paragraphs.hanzi: 他决定告别过去的生活，去一个新的城市重新开始。
paragraphs.pinyin: tā jué dìng gào bié guò qù de shēng huó ， qù yí gè xīn de chéng shì chóng xīn kāi shǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄍㄨㄛˋ ㄑㄩˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕㄥ ㄏㄨㄛˊ ， ㄑㄩˋ ㄧˊ ㄍㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄔㄥˊ ㄕˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Tā juédìng gàobié guòqù de shēnghuó, qù yí gè xīn de chéngshì chóngxīn kāishǐ.
paragraphs.translation: He decided to say goodbye to his past life and make a fresh start in a new city.
paragraphs.translation_en: He decided to say goodbye to his past life and make a fresh start in a new city.
paragraphs.translation_id: Dia memutuskan untuk melepaskan diri dari kehidupan lamanya dan memulai hidup baru di kota yang baru.

paragraphs.text: 这篇文章引用的材料很杂，需要重新整理。
paragraphs.hanzi: 这篇文章引用的材料很杂，需要重新整理。
paragraphs.pinyin: zhè piān wén zhāng yǐn yòng de cái liào hěn zá ， xū yào chóng xīn zhěng lǐ 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄆㄧㄢ ㄨㄣˊ ㄓㄤ ㄧㄣˇ ㄩㄥˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄘㄞˊ ㄌㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄣˇ ㄗㄚˊ ， ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄓㄥˇ ㄌㄧˇ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zhè piān wénzhāng yǐnyòng de cáiliào hěn zá, xūyào chóngxīn zhěnglǐ.
paragraphs.translation: The materials cited in this article are very mixed and need to be reorganized.
paragraphs.translation_en: The materials cited in this article are very mixed and need to be reorganized.
paragraphs.translation_id: Materi yang dikutip dalam artikel ini sangat beragam dan perlu ditata ulang.

paragraphs.text: 合同到期以后，双方可以重新商量待遇。
paragraphs.hanzi: 合同到期以后，双方可以重新商量待遇。
paragraphs.pinyin: hé tóng dào qī yǐ hòu ， shuāng fāng kě yǐ chóng xīn shāng liáng dài yù 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄏㄜˊ ㄊㄨㄥˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄑㄧ ㄧˇ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄕㄨㄤ ㄈㄤ ㄎㄜˇ ㄧˇ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄕㄤ ㄌㄧㄤˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄩˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Hétong dàoqī yǐhòu, shuāngfāng kěyǐ chóngxīn shāngliang dàiyù.
paragraphs.translation: After the contract expires, both sides can discuss the terms again.
paragraphs.translation_en: After the contract expires, both sides can discuss the terms again.
paragraphs.translation_id: Setelah kontrak berakhir, kedua belah pihak dapat mendiskusikan kembali persyaratannya.

paragraphs.text: 在他最困难的时候，亲情给了他重新开始的力量。
paragraphs.hanzi: 在他最困难的时候，亲情给了他重新开始的力量。
paragraphs.pinyin: zài tā zuì kùn nán de shí hòu ， qīn qíng gěi le tā chóng xīn kāi shǐ de lì liàng 。
paragraphs.zhuyin: ㄗㄞˋ ㄊㄚ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄎㄨㄣˋ ㄋㄢˊ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄏㄡˋ ， ㄑㄧㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˊ ㄍㄟˇ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄊㄚ ㄔㄨㄥˊ ㄒㄧㄣ ㄎㄞ ㄕˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄌㄧˋ ㄌㄧㄤˋ 。
paragraphs.romanization: Zài tā zuì kùnnan de shíhou, qīnqíng gěi le tā chóngxīn kāishǐ de lìliàng.
paragraphs.translation: At his most difficult time, family affection gave him the strength to start again.
